# Copilot / AI agent onboarding — ElearningDashboardNew

Purpose: give a concise, actionable snapshot so an AI coding agent can be productive immediately in this repo.

1) Big-picture architecture
- Backend: small Flask app in `backend/` (entry: `backend/app.py`). Data layer uses SQLAlchemy via `backend/extensions.py` (`db = SQLAlchemy()`), models live in `backend/models.py`. The app auto-creates an SQLite DB file `db.sqlite` in `backend/` at startup.
- Frontend: React single-page app in `frontend/` built with `react-scripts` + `react-bootstrap` (see `frontend/package.json`). Main UI lives under `frontend/src/` — `App.js` coordinates pages and holds a minimal in-memory auth state. Components: `Dashboard`, `Quiz`, `Forum`, `Login`, `Navbar`, `Sidebar`, `Loader`.

2) Critical integration points & endpoints (examples)
- Backend endpoints implemented in `backend/app.py`:
  - `GET /create-tables` — recreate DB tables
  - `GET /init-data` — inserts sample user/module/quiz/progress/badge data
  - `POST /login` — accepts JSON {email, password}; returns user on success
  - `GET|POST /forum` — list and post forum items
  - `GET /badges` — list badges

- Frontend usages to match: `frontend/src/components/*` fetch hard-coded `http://localhost:5000` paths. Important examples:
  - Dashboard fetches `GET /progress` and `GET /badges` (see `Dashboard.js`). Note: `/progress` is not implemented in `app.py` — either add an endpoint returning array of {module, status, score, streak} or update the frontend to consume an available route.
  - Quiz component fetches `GET /quiz/1` and posts answers to `POST /quiz/1` (see `Quiz.js`) — `/quiz/*` endpoints are not present and should be added if you implement quiz functionality.
  - Login posts to `POST /login` and expects JSON with `user` object (see `Login.js` and `App.js` where onLogin sets `user` state).

3) Project-specific patterns & conventions
- No token-based auth: the app uses a simple in-memory user object passed from `Login` to `App` (no JWT/session cookie). Be aware when adding auth: update frontend state and/or swap to token flow.
- Database: SQLite file `db.sqlite` is created automatically; migrations are not present. If you add models, call `db.create_all()` (used on startup) or add a migration workflow.
- Server dev run: `app.py` runs Flask directly with debug=True on port 5000.
- Frontend: UI uses `react-bootstrap` components and some Tailwind classes in the Login component (tailwind is present in devDependencies). Styles are in `frontend/src/App.css`.

4) Developer workflows (how to run locally)
- Backend (Windows PowerShell):
  - cd to backend: `cd backend`
  - create a venv and activate: `python -m venv .venv; .\.venv\Scripts\Activate` 
  - install minimal deps (inferred from imports): `pip install flask flask-cors flask-sqlalchemy werkzeug`
  - run: `python app.py` (server starts on port 5000; it will create `db.sqlite` and tables automatically)

- Frontend (Windows PowerShell):
  - cd to frontend: `cd frontend`
  - install deps: `npm install`
  - run dev server: `npm start` (uses react-scripts; app expects backend on http://localhost:5000)
